summary: Kootenai NF site about 15 miles north of Noxon, Sanders Co., Montana; a 1935 camp, abandoned 1942; no later account found.

events.note: Firelookout.com entry reads '1935: camp'; the entry does not say what the camp was.

evidence.supports: first two Forest Service lookouts built in Sanders County
evidence.quote: Montana's first two Forest Service lookouts were built in Sanders County
there were 82 lookouts in Sanders County

notes_for_editor: Only one lookout-specific source (firelookout.com, a four-line entry), so the story is short. The record's status 'gone' is not stated by the source, which says only 'Abandoned 1942'; the story does not say the structure is gone. Record elevation_m is null; the source gives 6779 ft only. The metric figure (about 2,067 m) is a conversion, not on the page, so the story leaves it out. Record point 48.22183, -115.73573 matches the Scotty Peak marker on the firelookout.com Montana map (data/raw/firelookout_com/MTmap.html). No staffing, design, build or fire history was found in the searches. The Sanders County Ledger feature (source 2) does not mention Scotty Peak. Not to be confused with the Numa Ridge or Glacier Park staffing entries that also come up in searches.
